insight: Built by All Hands AI, co-founded by CMU professor Graham Neubig; raised a $5M seed led by Menlo Ventures in 2024.
name: OpenHands
tagline: Open-source autonomous SWE agent. Successor to OpenDevin.
description: Self-hostable agent platform with a browser, terminal, and editor in a sandbox — comparable to Devin in shape, open in licence. Active research community pushing the autonomous-SWE bar.
edge: Leading open-source, self-hostable Devin-style SWE agent — read the code, swap any model, run your own sandbox.
pros: Browser, terminal, and editor in a sandbox
Inspect and modify the full codebase
cons: Autonomy still hit-or-miss on complex tasks
